documents.doc-cz-mz-2026-09-01-mzdr-21970-2026-3-m: The Czech Ministry of Health answered ten freedom-of-information questions submitted by Ganja For All Animals, z.s. about the collection, storage and transport of blood samples, blood and blood components. It cited the applicable legislation, the ČSN EN ISO 15189:2023 standard and professional guidance, and described storage temperatures, validation of transport boxes and vehicles, and transport monitoring. At the same time, the Ministry stated that it held neither the requested record and protocol templates nor inspection findings, methodological positions or records of temperature or time deviations since 1 January 2021, and refused those parts of the request. It identified the State Institute for Drug Control as the supervisory authority for blood banks, blood establishments and healthcare providers.
